'''Maal''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located at the intersection of the [[Authority Guardian Corridor]] and the [[Trianii Shunt]], in space annexed by the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] in [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was orbited by [[Hiit]], a moon that was the [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] of the avian [[Hiitian/Legends|Hiitians]].
